items.html: And know, that because ZA already had HGT and they became KHB, therefore also in the first brain it teaches: 'another brain was made,' to say that it was Gevura and became Bina, and became another brain from what it was. And this second brain, of Hochma, was not clothed in Bina, but was drawn from the Hochma and passed through Bina as a mere passage, and entered the head of ZA. And this is what is said: 'that other one — that radiance that was drawn from it, from it alone,' as I explained.
